name: AfroLatine Nights
description: Dance the night away to electrifying AfroLatine rhythms at Muxima Bar, featuring diverse music and a lively, welcoming atmosphere.
longDescription:
AfroLatine Nights is a recurring nightlife event at Muxima Bar, dedicated to showcasing the diverse musical heritage of Afro-Latin cultures. The event series aims to provide a platform for rhythms spanning from salsa and bachata to kizomba and afrobeat, celebrating the fusion and evolution of these sounds. It is organized by local promoters with a focus on creating an inclusive space for dance and cultural appreciation.

Attendees can expect an evening characterized by energetic music and a communal atmosphere, suitable for both experienced dancers and those new to the styles. The event typically runs for several hours into the early morning. Muxima Bar offers an intimate setting, conducive to dancing and social interaction. The audience is generally composed of individuals interested in global music and dance, encompassing a range of ages.

Admission is typically available at the door, with walk-ins welcome. Muxima Bar is located in central Porto, within walking distance of the Trindade metro station (approximately 5 minutes). Specific accessibility information is not available. The event is intended for an adult audience.
